commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
90+3' 0 - 2 Goal! Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Marko Dmitrovic.
90+3' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+2' Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul after Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) hacks down one of his opponents. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Girona!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
89' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alex Moreno (Girona) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
86' The linesman points to the corner flag, Girona are going to take it.
85' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
82' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Substitution. Joel Roca (Girona) has come on for Viktor Tsygankov.
81' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Pol Lozano and he is replaced by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
81' Jofre (Espanyol) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
81' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' Jofre (Espanyol) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.

79' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
76' Iosu Galech shows a yellow card to Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) for his blatant foul.
76' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
75' Espanyol take a short corner kick.
73' Substitution. Thomas Lemar makes his way off the pitch and Yaser Asprilla (Girona) comes on as his replacement.
73' Here is a change. Bryan Gil is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Alejandro Frances (Girona).
71' Great solo effort from Alex Moreno (Girona)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the right post.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kike Garcia (Espanyol) will replace Pere Milla.
69' Although Joel Roca (Girona) is just on the bench, Iosu Galech has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
67' CLOSE! Jofre (Espanyol) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar.
67' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

65' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Paulo Gazzaniga is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
64' Jofre (Espanyol) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
64' The attendance for today's match is 28451.
61' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
59' Jofre (Espanyol) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the left post.

58' Jofre (Espanyol) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the right post. Paulo Gazzaniga has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
57' The ball is behind the sideline. Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol) takes a throw-in.
56' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Omar El Hilali will be replaced by Ruben Sanchez (Espanyol).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) replaces Exposito.
55' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
54' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
54' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing.
52' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
51' Hugo Rincon (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
50' Neat passing move from Espanyol in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tyrhys Dolan leaves the pitch and Jofre (Espanyol) comes on.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Iosu Galech blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' 0 - 1 Goal! Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Marko Dmitrovic to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
45+2' The ref indicates that Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) must retake the penalty!
45+2' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) misses the penalty. He fired the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulled off a tremendous diving save to deny him.
45+2' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is going to take the penalty!
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' It must be a yellow card. It is. Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
45' Referee Iosu Galech sees the trip by Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Girona.
45' The referee signals a corner kick to Girona.
43' Pere Milla (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
42' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
40' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
37' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
36' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

35' Thomas Lemar (Girona) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Marko Dmitrovic shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
32' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) but poses no threat.
31' Arnau Martinez (Girona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Iosu Galech had an easy-decision to make.
27' Thomas Lemar (Girona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
26' Girona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' The ball is cleared after Alex Moreno (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

25' Paulo Gazzaniga makes a brilliant save! Carlos Romero (Espanyol) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
23' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is about to take a goal kick.
19' Bryan Gil (Girona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
18' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
17' Poor challenge! Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) is penalised for tripping and Iosu Galech blows his whistle.
15' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Bryan Gil (Girona).
12' The ball is out of play. Espanyol will have a throw-in.
8' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
5' Espanyol are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
2' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
2' Iosu Galech blows his whistle after Pere Milla (Espanyol) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Espanyol will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Iosu Galech.
